acceptance_criteria.description: A deterministic test connects two active sessions in the same Littleroot partition using warp sequences 7 and 41 and proves mutual spawn visibility.
The test proves an adjacent interaction succeeds when observed_warp_sequence is 41 and fails without mutation when the caller substitutes 7.
Focused server presence tests, strict Clippy, formatting, and diff checks pass with only the owned test module changed.

closed_decisions: Warp sequences are player-local; the shared server partition key is build, shard, region, map group, map number, and channel, excluding warp sequence.
The production server behavior is already correct and must not be changed by this unit.
The regression uses two distinct accounts and active leases in Hoenn Littleroot, with source warp 7 and target warp 41.
A valid interaction must observe the target's published warp 41; substituting the source's warp 7 must be rejected.
forbidden_changes: Do not change production presence behavior, public APIs, message codecs, storage, authentication, realtime transport, Cargo files, documentation, or orchestration state.
Do not weaken region, map, channel, build, lease, handle, sequence, adjacency, or elevation checks.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, create or remove worktrees, or revert another worker's edits.
objective: Add a server regression proving that two players with distinct nonzero warp histories can share one regional map partition and interact only with the target's published warp sequence.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and all verification outcomes are recorded.
The regression exposes a production defect requiring changes outside the owned test file.
A concrete toolchain or isolated-worktree failure prevents progress within the execution budget.
